audit_title: Final Methodology Audit Before ML Completion
auditor: Senior Machine Learning Engineer and Independent Technical Auditor

project_directive.target_accuracy_80_status: Formally abandoned; ~71.4% cross-validated accuracy accepted as scientifically and practically sound
project_directive.integrity_commitment: No data manipulation, leakage, label distortion, or customer exclusion permitted

experiment_grid_coverage.rationale: Evaluated linear baselines across all 4 configs, non-linear tree ensembles on advanced features (Config C), and correlation pruning on top candidates (Config D).

optimism_disclosures.candidate_selection_optimism: random_forest_config_d is the sample maximum across 12 evaluated candidates; expected to exhibit mild shrinkage on unseen data.
optimism_disclosures.threshold_selection_optimism: Threshold tau = 0.40 maximizes empirical F1 (0.7061) on pooled development OOF predictions; must be independently validated on sealed test cohort.

pipeline_artifact_verification.refit_scope: Full 100% development dataset (train + validation), verified not an outer fold subset

bayes_error_analysis.methodological_note: The 26.03% figure assumes knowledge of latent personas. Conditional on observable features X, Bayes error R*(X) >= 26.03%. 73.97% is an oracle ceiling assuming latent knowledge, not a proven universal ceiling on X. Chasing 80% accuracy is mathematically unfeasible without label leakage.

audit_recommendation.recommendation: Approve Phase 5.1 Checkpoint 3 candidate selection and proceed to Phase 5.1 Checkpoint 4 (Candidate Validation, Final Model Comparison & Production Selection).
